title: map_snapshot_manifest.v1
description: Cold S3 (or files) index for one immutable map snapshot version. Lists node/edge chunk object keys under map/<tenant>/snapshots/<version>/. Not a substitute for graph_node.v1 / graph_edge.v1 row schemas.

version.description: Snapshot generation id (ISO-8601 or monotonic string). Must match Dest path segment.

node_parts.description: Relative keys such as nodes/part-00000.jsonl.gz under this version prefix.

edge_parts.description: Relative keys such as edges/part-00000.jsonl.gz under this version prefix.
